title: Keyboard Manager: remaps with alt as the only modifier key have to be pressed twice before it work
author: ReginaldTang
summary: Keyboard Manager and Command Palette shortcuts need a second keypress when they share Grab and Move's configured modifier; the same defect is tracked more completely in #47802.
next_action: Consolidate the report into #47802 and use its modifier-arbitration fix path.

confidence.rationale: The public discussion and linked ownership evidence support this classification.

judgment.rationale: This is the same Grab and Move modifier-capture failure tracked with clearer cross-application evidence in #47802, with related Win-key variants in #47585 and #47337.
evidence: Turning Grab and Move off immediately restores Keyboard Manager remaps.
Changing Grab and Move from Alt to Win transfers the double-press behavior to Win shortcuts.
The same keyboard-only modifier suppression is documented in #47802.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate the report into #47802 and use its modifier-arbitration fix path.

fix_assessment.rationale: The PowerToys fix is applicable but should be designed once in canonical issue #47802 rather than independently here.

issue_context.summary: Keyboard Manager and Command Palette shortcuts need a second keypress when they share Grab and Move's configured modifier; the same defect is tracked more completely in #47802.
known_information: The issue reproduces with Alt-only and Win-based shortcuts.
Disabling Grab and Move removes the failure.
The failure starts after PowerToys restart and depends on hook ordering.
inferences: A single Grab and Move modifier-capture correction should address all of these reports.
issue_context.analysis: A separate plan would duplicate the canonical investigation. This issue should contribute its Keyboard Manager/Command Palette cases to #47802.
initial_investigation: Reviewed every live comment and all linked related-issue references.
Confirmed #47802 remains open with the clearest cross-application description.

actions.label: Close as Grab and Move modifier duplicate
actions.note: Draft only; no comment, close, label, or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body: Thanks for confirming that disabling Grab and Move restores the remap and that selecting Win transfers the same double-press behavior to Win shortcuts. This is the modifier-capture problem tracked with broader keyboard-only evidence in #47802 (with related cases in #47585 and #47337). This issue can be closed as a duplicate and its Keyboard Manager/Command Palette scenarios retained there.
